description: Re-run the triage copilot's verdict check whenever a generated report draft is saved, so a hand-edited draft cannot drift away from the pipeline verdict.
name: report-draft-check

onFailure.message: Report draft check failed: the saved draft does not match the copilot verdict. Re-run `python3 triage.py data/fixtures/<id>.json` to regenerate it.

then.description: Re-check the saved report draft against the pipeline verdict for its finding id.
